notes.title: Double Memory is now Available for macOS - OSX
notes.content:
You can now Play Double Memory  on your Mac Computers!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30684340/f5ee965c5dffce528103b72456057fb96f7c3be1.png[/img]


If you have Steam installed on your Mac computer and have already acquired a copy of Double Memory on Steam, you should now see Double Memory in your Library. 

If you don't already own Double Memory, you can get the game and it will download the appropriate version of the game to your computer when you press the play/install button. 

Thank you for your support and please contact us via the support email if you have any questions or issues with the Mac version of Double Memory. 

-Double Memory Team


NOTE: 7/10/2018  -

We had some users mention compatability issue with multi-monitor support. 

Short term solution that seems to be working is disabling steam overlay when in game. And we're working on a permanent solution as well.

notes.title: NEW PATCH - Double Memory v1.0104
notes.content:
On 09/24/2017 - Double Memory v1.0104 Patch was implemented.

The Double Memory Team has added a new button in the Options area.

If you click on the "STAR ANIMATIONS" toggle button, you can disable the Star Animation for correct answers.

NOTE: If you complete beat a stage the Star Animation will still play during a stage victory animation. 

ALSO!!!

We added screenshot support. So know users should be able to upload screenshots.

-Double Memory Team

notes.title: Double Memory v1.0101 Patch Notes - Fixed Final Achievement
notes.content:
Greetings Double Memory Players:

Big thanks to "JeLomun" for pointing out that the Achievement for beating the final stage was not properly initializing.

We have patched this issue and tested the achievement with version 1.0101 of Double Memory.


Players will need to beat the final stage again in order to properly activate the achievement known as "Spinning with Victory".

Thank you again JeLomun for being the first to let us know about this. 

-Double Memory Team

notes.title: Double Memory is OK to Stream on Twitch and Youtube and other services with Monetization
notes.content:
Dear Double Memory Players:

Please have fun Streaming and Using Monetization on your Streams of Double Memory. 

For example, if you have a Twitch account and want to Stream this game, if there are any questions from Twitch about the legality of Streaming Double Memory, just refer them to this post. 

If you are a Youtube Streamer or make Youtube Videos, feel free to play Double Memory and also it is OK for you to Monetize your videos with this game's content.

In fact, Overidon Omnimedia is looking forward to being 100% Streamer / Online Gaming / Monetization friendly for future releases as well as Double Memory.

Also, we will be adding a section to the legal lines of Double Memory on Steam describing this clarification.

Hopefully this clarifies that Double Memory is OK to stream, make videos of, and also Monetize your streams / videos with Double Memory in that creation. 

Sincerely,

Tyler Stansfield Jaggers

Double Memory Team
